guideContent.strategyOverview: Azorius stax + control/combo deck exploiting Shorikai's unique status as a Vehicle, not a creature. This dodges creature removal, board wipes, summoning sickness, and crucially enables Humility (all creatures become 1/1 vanilla) and Cursed Totem (shuts creature activated abilities) without affecting Shorikai at all. Use Shorikai as a repeatable card advantage engine ({1}, tap: draw 2, discard 1, make a Pilot token) under devastating stax locks while assembling one of two independent 2-card combos. Line A: Isochron Scepter + Dramatic Reversal for infinite mana → draw entire deck with Shorikai → Blue Sun's Zenith each opponent. Line B: Rest in Peace + Helm of Obedience → exile an opponent's entire library (officially ruled interaction). The deck runs 10 asymmetric board wipes that all spare Shorikai (Vehicle) and leave you with creatures to crew — White Sun's Twilight, Martial Coup, and Sunfall create tokens post-wipe, while Fell the Mighty and The Battle of Bywater spare your small Pilots. Elspeth, Storm Slayer doubles ALL token creation including Shorikai's Pilots.

winConditions.title: Isochron Scepter + Dramatic Reversal
winConditions.description: Imprint Dramatic Reversal on Isochron Scepter. With 3+ mana from nonland permanents (trivial with 10 mana rocks), activate Scepter for {2} to cast Dramatic Reversal, untapping all nonland permanents including Scepter and Shorikai. Net positive mana each loop. Infinite mana → activate Shorikai infinitely → draw entire deck → Blue Sun's Zenith each opponent or Aetherflux Reservoir storm kill. Works through Humility (all artifacts, no creatures involved).

winConditions.title: Rest in Peace + Helm of Obedience
winConditions.description: With Rest in Peace on the battlefield, activate Helm of Obedience for {1} targeting an opponent. Helm mills until a card is put into the graveyard — but RIP exiles all cards instead. The graveyard condition is never met, so Helm exiles the opponent's entire library. They lose on their next draw. Repeat for each opponent by untapping Helm (Voltaic Key, Manifold Key, Unwinding Clock, or Dramatic Reversal). Confirmed by official WotC ruling. Both pieces are independently powerful stax.

winConditions.title: Humility Lock + Planeswalker Beatdown
winConditions.description: Backup win path when combos are disrupted. Humility makes all creatures 1/1 vanilla, shutting down opponents' boards. Shorikai keeps drawing cards (not a creature). Elspeth, Sun's Champion creates 3 Soldiers per turn; Elspeth, Storm Slayer doubles all token creation. Asymmetric wraths clear the board while your tokens survive. Slowly overwhelm with 1/1 token army — opponents can't rebuild meaningfully under Humility.

synergies.title: Humility + Shorikai (Vehicle Advantage)
synergies.description: Humility makes all creatures 1/1 with no abilities. Shorikai is a Vehicle (artifact), not a creature — completely unaffected. Activate {1}, {T} to draw 2, discard 1, make Pilot tokens while opponents' entire boards are neutered. Do NOT crew Shorikai under Humility — crewing makes it a creature, turning it into a 1/1 with no abilities.

synergies.title: Cursed Totem + Shorikai
synergies.description: Cursed Totem prevents creature activated abilities. Shorikai's {1}, {T} ability is an artifact ability (Vehicle, not creature) — unaffected. Opponents' mana dorks, creature-based commanders, and activated abilities are all shut down while Shorikai operates normally.

synergies.title: Elspeth, Storm Slayer Token Doubling
synergies.description: Elspeth, Storm Slayer's static ability doubles all token creation. Shorikai's {1}, {T} ability creates 2 Pilot tokens instead of 1. White Sun's Twilight creates 2X Mite tokens. Martial Coup creates 2X Soldiers. Dramatically accelerates crewing (only 2 Shorikai activations to crew instead of 3) and token army buildup.

synergies.title: Narset + Windfall Soft Lock
synergies.description: With Narset on the battlefield, cast Windfall. All players discard their hands and draw cards equal to the greatest number discarded — but Narset restricts opponents to drawing only 1 card. You draw a full hand; opponents are left with 1 card each.

synergies.title: Unwinding Clock + Shorikai
synergies.description: Unwinding Clock untaps all artifacts during each opponent's untap step. Shorikai is an artifact. In a 4-player game, Shorikai untaps 4 times per turn cycle (your untap + 3 opponents'). That's 4 activations: draw 8, discard 4, create 4 Pilot tokens per full turn cycle. Mana rocks also untap, providing {1} to activate each time.

synergies.title: Skullclamp + Pilot Tokens
synergies.description: Equip Skullclamp to a 1/1 Pilot token — it becomes 2/0 and dies immediately (state-based action). Draw 2 cards from Skullclamp's death trigger. Each Shorikai activation creates a Pilot, and each Pilot converts to 2 cards via Skullclamp for {1} equip cost. Anti-synergy: under Rest in Peace, tokens are exiled (don't 'die'), so Skullclamp doesn't trigger. Use Skullclamp before deploying RIP.

synergies.title: Asymmetric Board Wipes
synergies.description: All creature-based wraths spare Shorikai (Vehicle, not creature). White Sun's Twilight and Martial Coup destroy all OTHER creatures while creating tokens for you. Sunfall exiles all creatures and leaves an Incubator artifact. After any wrath, activate Shorikai to immediately start producing new Pilot tokens to crew.

highlights.name: Humility
highlights.reason: THE reason to play Shorikai. All creatures become 1/1 vanilla. Shorikai (Vehicle) is completely unaffected — keeps drawing cards and making tokens while opponents' entire creature-based strategies are neutralized.

highlights.name: Isochron Scepter
highlights.reason: Primary combo piece. Imprint Dramatic Reversal for infinite mana with 3+ mana from nonland permanents. Tutorable by Enlightened Tutor, Fabricate, Muddle the Mixture (CMC 2), and Whir of Invention.

highlights.name: Helm of Obedience
highlights.reason: Second combo line with Rest in Peace. Exiles an opponent's entire library for just {1} activation. Both pieces are independently useful stax cards. Tutorable by Enlightened Tutor and Fabricate.

highlights.name: Elspeth, Storm Slayer
highlights.reason: Static ability doubles ALL token creation. Shorikai makes 2 Pilots per activation. Wrath tokens are doubled. +1 creates 2 Soldiers. Unaffected by Humility and creature wraths (planeswalker).
